# Wodouh (وضوح)

> Saudi employment-rights guidance for workers. Every legal claim is verified
> against official Saudi sources, carries its article number and source link,
> and shows the date it was last checked.

Wodouh explains Saudi Labor Law to employees — what they may be owed, what
their contract says, and what they can do next. The answer pages are generated
from a register of 29 independently verified claims; a claim that is disputed,
or verified only in part, produces no page at all rather than a hedged one.
Article 53 (probation) is under open dispute and is deliberately absent.

Calculations run on the reader's device. Wodouh is not a law firm and states
no legal outcome.

NOTE FOR EDITORS: the "29" above is the count of strictly verified rows in
docs/legal-sources.md, which test/seo.test.js asserts. If the register grows,
this file is a second place that number lives and must be updated with it.

## Verified answers
- [All answers (English)](https://alwodouh.com/answers/): 29 verified rules, one page each, with article number, official source and verification date.
- [All answers (Arabic)](https://alwodouh.com/answers/ar/): the same register in Arabic.

## Methodology
- [How we verify](https://alwodouh.com/how-we-verify/): what enters the register, what is excluded, and why a disputed rule produces no page.

## Tools
- [Wodouh](https://alwodouh.com/app/): end-of-service calculator and contract review. Figures are computed on the reader's device.
